hypotheses.binder: 0 < t (the third premise of the ∀ t, … statement, named h0 in the proof)
hypotheses.justification: The first premise h1 already says (723732917263 / 2560000000000 : ℝ) ≤ t, and this lower bound is about 0.2827, so it is positive. Then 0 < t follows from `lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h1`. The proof only uses h0 to pass it on to tc_302 and tc_303, which need 0 < t. Without h0, define `h0 : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 723732917263 / 2560000000000) h1` and pass it to both calls. In the tc_303 branch, t > 4542766622207/16000000000000 > 0, so the same h0 works there too. Nothing else in the statement changes.
